lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : {i}Do I need to come over and, like...bring you something? What do you want?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}需要我过去一趟，给你带点什么吗？你想要什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}a hug!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个抱抱！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then you will need to get out of the bath first.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你得先从浴缸里出来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}you can hug me in the bath its okay {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你可以在浴缸里抱我呀，没关系的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}unless you dont like chinami when shes wet{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除非你不喜欢湿漉漉的 Chinami{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t like when she uses language like that, that’s for sure.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我可不喜欢她用那种措辞，这点毫无疑问。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}why not chinami didnt say any bad words{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么不行 Chinami 又没说脏话{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chinami will one day understand why some of her word choices are bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 总有一天会明白，她有些用词是不妥的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}papa will one day give chinami a wet bath hug{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}爸爸总有一天会给 Chinami 一个湿漉漉的浴缸抱抱{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Stop it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别说了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}wet wet wet chinami is so very wet!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}湿湿湿 Chinami 现在湿透了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m turning off my phone now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我要关手机了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}but what if chinami drowns{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可万一 Chinami 淹死了怎么办{/i}

lines.en: : {i}you need to keep your phone on so you can call the ambulance for her{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你得开着手机，才能替她叫救护车啊{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Or, alternatively, you could get out of the bath and text me while you have clothes on. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者，你也可以先从浴缸里出来，穿上衣服再跟我发消息。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}if chinami does that will papa come bring her things like candy and a towel to fix how wet she is{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是 Chinami 这么做，爸爸会给她带点糖果和毛巾，好治治她身上的湿吗{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You have plenty of towels in your house, Chinami. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami，你家里毛巾多得是。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}but chinami is dying and weak and cant reach them so she needs your help{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可 Chinami 快死了，虚弱得够不到，所以需要你帮忙{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What’s wrong with you this time?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这次又是怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}probably karma from all the cruelty chinami inflicts on others behind everyones back{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概是报应吧，Chinami 背地里对别人使的那些坏{/i}

lines.en: : {i}she just returned from robbing a bank and maybe someone was sick there{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她刚抢完银行回来，说不定那儿有人生病了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}who knows!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谁知道呢！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I will bring you soup as soon as I can. Please do not rob me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会尽快给你送汤过去。别抢劫我就行。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}chinami makes no promises! bye dry papa! wet chinami loves you!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 不做任何保证！再见啦干巴巴的爸爸！湿漉漉的 Chinami 爱你！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Also, please delete all of these messages from your phone. Thanks.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有，请把这些消息从你手机里都删掉。谢谢。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}noooo chinamis precious memories!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不要嘛 Chinami 宝贵的回忆！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chinami, you can not send me pictures like this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami，你不能给我发这种照片。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}chinami understands{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 明白了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}she tried to hide the rubber ducks but they just kept floating back{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她想把橡皮鸭藏起来，可它们一直浮回来{/i}

lines.en: : {i}she is sorry she knows you are afraid of them{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她很抱歉，她知道你害怕它们{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That is not why you can’t send me pictures like this, Chinami.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你不能给我发这种照片，不是因为这个，Chinami。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In fact, just don’t send me pictures at all. My phone is a hot bed for inappropriate content as is.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}事实上，你干脆什么都别发给我。我手机里已经是不健康内容的温床了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}chinami wants to see the inappropriate content on papas phone!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 想看爸爸手机里的不健康内容！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chinami will never see any such thing and should forget I even said that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 永远看不到那种东西，也该把我刚才那句话忘掉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}okay chinami will forget all about the inappropriate content and your fear of rubber ducks{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好的，Chinami 会把不健康内容和你怕橡皮鸭的事全忘掉{/i}

lines.en: : {i}but she has a request!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过她有个请求！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}she wants you to send her a picture next so she can set it as her phone wallpaper!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她想让你也发一张过来，好设成手机壁纸！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Set your sister or Yumi as your wallpaper. Or a TV show or something. It’ll be weird if its me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}把姐姐或者 Yumi 设成壁纸吧。或者电视剧什么的。用我的话会很怪。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}no it wont papa is big sis chikas wallpaper and chinami thinks its a good picture its very cute!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}才不会怪呢，Chika 姐姐的壁纸就是爸爸，Chinami 觉得那是张好照片，特别可爱！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}maybe we can take one together next time you come over!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也许下次你来的时候我们可以一起拍一张！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}that would make chinami very happy!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那会让 Chinami 非常开心！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Fine. But only if you agree to not send me things like this anymore. Understood?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧。但条件是你要答应，以后不再给我发这种东西。明白吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why not?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么不要？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}because chinami is a free woman with unlimited data!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为 Chinami 是个自由女性，还有无限流量！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}shell make a compromise and agree if papa shows her the inappropriate content though{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过要是爸爸给她看不健康内容，她倒是可以妥协答应{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not gonna happen.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}想都别想。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}then she hopes youre ready for more bath time chinami pictures!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那她就准备好迎接更多 Chinami 洗澡时间的照片吧！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}shes gonna dry off and take another one now!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她现在要去擦干身体再拍一张！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I am going to throw my phone off a bridge.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而我要把手机从桥上扔下去了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You need to stop calling yourself my daughter, Chinami. It’s not healthy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你别再管自己叫我的女儿了，Chinami。这样不健康。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}nothing about chinami is healthy so shes going to keep doing it anyway{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 身上没有一样东西是健康的，所以她要继续这么叫{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It really doesn’t make you uncomfortable?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真的一点都不别扭吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}why would chinami be uncomfortable when she is in the bath{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 在洗澡，为什么会别扭{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The bath has nothing to do with it. It’s just that you’ve been calling me that since you met me pretty much.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}跟洗澡没关系。只是你从认识我起差不多就这么叫我了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}if chinami did it wrong its because she doesnt have any experience calling anybody papa since her first one hated her{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是 Chinami 叫错了，那是因为她没有管任何人叫爸爸的经验，她的第一个爸爸讨厌她{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I doubt he hated you. He was probably just a bad father. That happens sometimes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我怀疑他不是讨厌你。他大概只是个糟糕的父亲。这种事时有发生。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because some people aren’t ready for kids. Raising a child is hard.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为有些人没准备好要孩子。养孩子很难。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}chinami thinks she understands{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 觉得她懂了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}big sis chika says doctors bills are expensive so maybe he was just a business man too and needed the capital{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chika 姐姐说医药费很贵，所以也许他只是个生意人，需要资金{/i}

lines.en: : {i}do you think thats where chinami gets her entrepreneurial prowess{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你觉得 Chinami 的商业头脑是不是就是打那儿来的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How can you type things like “entrepreneurial prowess” but leave out apostrophes and other punctuations?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你打得出来「商业头脑」这种词，却连撇号和其他标点都不打？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}chinami is too busy to be bothered with apostrophes time is money papa shes got bills to pay{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 太忙了，没空管撇号，时间就是金钱爸爸，她还有账单要付{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You don’t pay any bills, Chinami.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你根本一分账单都不用付，Chinami。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}you dont know that and for all anybody knows maybe chinami is maxing out her roth ira every year have you ever thought about that{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你又不知道，说不定 Chinami 每年都把罗斯个人退休账户缴满呢，你想过没有{/i}

lines.en: : {i}compound interest papa chinami is going to make this family rich!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}复利啊爸爸，Chinami 要让这个家发财！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}unless she dies :({/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除非她死了 :({/i}

lines.en: : {i}You are not going to die.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你不会死的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}but everyone dies{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可是人都会死{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Everyone except Chinami. I’ll make sure of it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除了 Chinami 以外的人都会。我会确保这一点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}your text can not be completed because chinami is dead we are so very sorry goodbye this number is disconnected now{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您的短信无法发送因为 Chinami 已经死了非常抱歉再见这个号码现已停用{/i}
